## Checklist

- [ ] URL is live and uses the clean official homepage or GitHub repo (no `?utm_*` or referral links).
- [ ] Not a duplicate of an existing entry.
- [ ] Directly useful for faceless YouTube / Shorts / TikTok creation.
- [ ] Free, open-source, or has a meaningful free tier (not a paid-only prompt pack or thin wrapper).
- [ ] Matches the table column format in `README.md`.
